notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.7 - Localizations Update
notes.notes:
Hello Crafters,

New update today to complete the current Localizations of Crafty Survivors: Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese.
Now all the content is available in those languages.

We have also added an option to adjust the resolution in-game to the ones supported by the monitor used. This can help players with performance and adjusting the resolution to fit better for their needs.

Check the Patch Notes below for more detailed information on these changes.

Patch Notes - v1.0.7
New Graphics Setting
Resolution
New setting to allow players to change the resolution in-game, to better fit their needs.

General

Updated the localizations for Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese. These localizations are now complete!


Adjustments

Adjusted a few internal settings so the game can properly adjust itself to other resolutions outside of the most common 16:9.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.6 - Adjustments to Stages
notes.notes:
Hello Crafters,

We have made several changes to the Stages of Crafty Survivors to reduce the amount of enemies of most of the Stages up to the Desert area and we added a new statue to remove the spawn timer between each enemy for those who want a faster experience. This Statue, however, will make stages harder to complete as enemies will spawn without delay and swarm the area easily.
We've seen the community mentioning that some stages take too long, specially in Malignous mode for those who mostly play on it, so we decided to make some changes on the enemy count for Stages.
We decided not to change the amount of Stages in the game as this will affect progress and saves of all players, so we went into almost every stage of the game to rework the waves of enemies and their amounts.
Some stages were not impacted by this change, as they are later stages in the game, such as the Volcano Area or EX Stages which are meant to be challenges to complete.

Check the Patch Notes below for more detailed information on these changes.

Patch Notes - v1.0.6
New Statue
Cursed Bait
Added a new Statue to the Blessing System, available at the Sculptor's Gallery Level 9.
The new Statue removes the Time Between Enemies Spawn, making them all spawn instantly, regardless of difficulty, enemy health and stats.
New Accessibility Feature
Remove Malignous Visual Effect
Added an accessibility option to remove the Malignous Purple Visual Effect for players who find that filter too hard to see.

General

Updated a few localizations for Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese. These localizations will be fully completed as soon as possible.


Adjustments
ALMOST all Stages in the game
Most stages have their enemy count reduced, so Stages can be cleared faster in all difficulties;
Amount of Gold and Resources acquired by completing most Stages have been increased to compensate for the reduced enemy amount;
Increased the value of EXP dropped by all enemies to compensate for the reduced enemy amount, to keep the levelling process similar;
Volcano Stages were not changed;
Most EX Stages were not changed;
Challenge Stages were not changed;
Boss Stages were not changed.

Bug

Fixed some typos;
Fixed the tooltip of Well-oiled Machine as it was showing the wrong percentage for activation. This was just a tooltip issue, as the skill was functioning as intended.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1
Crafty Survivors - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey there, Crafters!

Today is the day to announce our Full Release Date! 1.0 version is coming soon, with 2 new characters for the roster, with the last area of Crafty Survivors!

Check out the Announcement Trailer Below:

[previewyoutube=W3CDHCHH9Kw;full][/previewyoutube]

After over 2 years of development and a lot more content added to the game compared to our initial plan and schedule, this feels like finishing a very long fun book. It has been such a wild journey! Bringing all these crazy characters and designs to life has been amazing.

We hope you all are excited to for this final version and the Full Release of Crafty Survivors!

Thank you all again for accompanying us through this Early Access and all the journey its been through! We really appreciate it.

notes.title: Daily Newton #13 - Upcoming 1.0 Release and Steam Community Items
notes.notes:
Hi Crafters,

How is everyone doing lately? 

We are very excited to be approaching the 1.0 Full Release of Crafty Survivors! Soon we will announce the release date of version 1.0 with another post here, more appropriate with the Release Date Announcement Trailer. So keep an eye out for that post, very soon!

We will also add the Spotlight Trailers for the last 2 characters of the game, Wallie and Newston. Those trailers will also be added here on the community before the release of 1.0.

As we mentioned before, after revealing all the characters of the game, we were going to make a pool with our community here and on our Discord to select the characters that would be added to the Steam Community Items for Trading Cards, that will be available at Full Release of the game. 

We are now adding a link to a Google Forms here, where players can vote on up to 6 characters they would like to see on the Cards. Votes will be counted up to May 12th 11:59 PM (EDT), and the top 6 voted characters will appear on the Trading Cards for the 1.0 version.
Players can vote on their favourites here: Steam Community Item Trading Card Form

Who is looking forward to both Wallie and Newston in the 1.0 release?

That is all for today, with the Daily Newton! 

Have a good day! And keep Crafty!

notes.title: Daily Newton #10 - Next Update and More!
notes.notes:
Hi Crafters,

How is everyone after all the spooky time?

We've been designing and planning a lot of cool stuff for the Master Talents of each character, which will bring the Talent Trees to their maximum potential. Some insane additions to each of the characters that will make their playstyle either SHINE even more or CHANGE in some drastic measures! These Talents of the Weaving and Smithing Systems are the focus of the next update of Crafty Survivors, with a few more Stages of the Desert, allowing players to further progress the strength of each character and the overall status of them all.

This update will have 2 new buildings in the Village as well, preparing the space for the 2 last characters of the game, as they are residents of the Village. The text won't spoil who they are or the name of the buildings for now, as they will be revealed after the debut of the Locksmith. Their materials won't be in the game either as they are from the last area, but we are already setting them up for the future.

After that update, we will continue the work on the 13th character to be added to the game, Keyra, the Locksmith. She will debut in-game with the rest of the Desert area and its challenges, to complete the cycle of the Early Access, as we move to the content update for the 1.0 of the game, which will add the 2 final characters and the last area!

We are also organizing the Announcement of our next project, to be revealed soon! As the development of Crafty Survivors approaches its final steps of the content, we have been planning what our next game would be and when we would reveal its Steam page and all. We have been really excited about this idea, with all its planning and everything! It's been quite hard not to talk about it. This next project is in a completely different genre and has nothing to do with Crafty Survivors.

For those wondering why we are already mentioning a next game if this one is not on its 1.0 yet, we have been debating that ourselves about when it's the most appropriate time to announce. To be as most transparent as possible, as I always like to be, Crafty Survivors hasn't been financially viable for almost a year now, but we are still committed to finishing its content to the possible extent of what was planned, and, because of that, we need to start thinking about the future of Flannel Bear Games and what we are able to do to continue creating the games we love. There are a few important dates next year that coincide with the game idea that we have and it would be a very appropriate time for our next step, so we definitely need to announce it before to start its existence and let people know about it.

That is all for today, with the Daily Newton! Hope everybody is excited for the new Talents soon!

More information in the future, so keep an eye out for it.

Have a good day! And keep Crafty!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.9.0.1
Patch Notes - v0.8.0.1
Daily Newton #7 - The Next Update
notes.notes:
Hi Crafters,

How is everyone lately? I hope you all have been doing good.

The development of the new content is going good so far, but as we mentioned before, it is taking longer since we are adding a lot of new things to complete the rest of the Cavern area in this update.

The update will have a brand new character, the Jeweller, as already revealed, 5 new bosses to fight, more than 100 new talents available to customize the characters, new elixir skills and new enemies to fight, along with several bug fixes from the reports that the community has sent. All of these takes time, so the update is still in process, but is moving forward nicely.

And of course, the adjustments to the difficulty modes, as discussed on the previous Daily Newton here on the Discussion Forum. Not only the changes on Malignous Mode, we are also making some big adjustments to the Easy Mode to fit more into an easy aspect. The amount of materials for Easy Mode will be increased and enemies will have their attack speed and movement speed decreased considerably, to give players more room to think as an Easy Mode should.

Malignous Mode will have its adjustments as well. We will test the change in this mode on the next update, so let us know what you all think about it and the differences it makes when the time comes. 

Also as the development of this new content moves forward, I have also started working on the art assets for the next part of the game, since I have to wait for my husband to implement and program a lot of stuff before testing the new mechanics/skills/enemies/etc. (For those who don't know, my husband is the programmer and I am the artist.) Hopefully this may speed up the next portion of the content a little bit. The 12th character is already designed and animated, and I think we could make a sneak peek of them here soon.

I guess that is all for today, with the Daily Newton! More information in the future, so keep an eye out for it.

Have a good day! And keep Crafty!

notes.title: Backup & Bug Fixes - v0.4.1.4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - v0.4.1.4

Backup Save File System
We implemented a new backup save file system to avoid loss of progress. Every 15 minutes the game will create a backup save file in the same folder as your normal save file. Upon starting the game and reaching the screen where you can select the areas to go, the game will check if your save was gone or reset and will restore it by making it the same as your backup.
We also changed when the game first tries to access your save to better ensure the steam integration is working properly before.

Backups will only be created with this update! The game doesn't have a backup of any save files prior to this and the first backup will only be created after 15 minutes of playing the game in version 0.4.1.4.

For players that choose to delete their save files on the settings screen, the backup will also be deleted.

We hope this new addition mitigates any loss of progress by players.

General

Players using keyboard and mouse can now click on the notifications at the bottom of the screen to close them faster. 


Adjustments
Stoverick, the Chef

Stoverick can now accumulate up to 2 Bistro Stacks per enemy when applying the 5 different status available to his arsenal of skills.
So now making an enemy chopped, spiced, roasted, candied and frosted will give two bistro stacks instead of one.


Hanvilton, the Blacksmith

Hanvilton can now dodge while performing the Stress Test skill to cancel it.


Foods
Breaded Tilapia nerf:

The effect has a cooldown of 1 second now.


General

Increased the radius used for collectables to merge with each other. We hope this reduces the amount of objects on the floor and increase overall performance;
Changed the quantity buttons of the Financing System and added a Max Invest button to change the value to the maximum amount possible.


Bug Fixes

Added a check to give the Breaded Tilapia recipe to players that used the latest restoration branch;
Fixed an issue with Corntling Gun's Skill Tree not displaying properly as some images were missing reference;
Fixed an issue with Sewing Journey not dealing damage to enemies;
Fixed some texts;
Fixed an issue when performing a Dual Axes Stress Test Skill while the Water Augment was active Hanvilton, creating way more food effects than intended;
Fixed an issue with the movement speed buff not being applied properly for enemies that are already very fast. We implemented a cap to avoid unfair enemies but it made enemies slower instead. That is fixed now and they just wont receive the buff.



Next Steps:
Now that we were able to adjust the game to have its own backup method, we hope this can help with any issues related to loss of progress. We were not able to replicate any loss of progress on our saves on different computers and the Steam Deck, so we were not able to figure out what could be the cause of the issue that plagued a few players so far. We know it is really frustrating and we hope this new update will help with this from now on.

We can now properly resume the development of the 8th character to join the roster of Crafty Survivors. Most of their animations and skills are already complete, and we will soon begin to implement them in the game. Here is another sneak peek on the character:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/345cbee4c746a226aafc0d91a9832d1bc83091df.gif
What is their profession?

We will also continue to adapt the game's structure to receive localizations in the near future. We already began to localize portion of the content in our native language and we will soon search for partners for other languages. So keep an eye out for it! We will add localizations as we are able to find appropriate partners for each language, so we ask for your patience while we are making these next steps.

As we mentioned before, we think it is good to remind everyone that the newest content of the game won't be released with their localization. As the game is in Early Access and there's always chance to balance new content after its release, we will wait some time before localizing any new content.

Thank you again everyone for all your patience and for playing Crafty Survivors! We hope everyone is having as much fun playing the game as we have developing and testing it.

Anyone excited for the next character?

As usual, we want to kindly ask everyone to leave us a review here on Steam when possible, please. The reviews help a lot with the game! So if you have some spare time, please leave as a review when you have a moment. The reviews are slowly growing up! 500 reviews is the next big step for Crafty Survivors, so please, help us achieve this milestone!
Thank you for everyone who already left a review!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.4.1.2
Bug Fixes - v0.4.0.6
Regarding Lost Save Files *Update*
notes.notes:
*Edit* After posting this notice, we had an idea to possibly help with lost saves.
We are going to work on adding a branch on the game that will allow players to recover some of their lost progress. We are still discussing how it's going to work and the specifics of it. Since we can't know the specifics of each save file to get back the exact progress of the game, we are planning on a way that a player can temporarily change the game's branch and alter the game's progress to certain predetermined thresholds. We know this is not the perfect solution, but this at least gives an option for players to recover some of their lost progress without starting from the beginning.
After we implement this, we will create a notice with all the steps to adjust the save files for the players that lost it.

Hello everyone,

We are really sad to hear that some players reported losing their save files and wanted to make some points clear as well as provide some instructions that may help with this situation.

The saving system of our game only save files locally on your computer. We do not own a server or database that hold this info, therefore we don't have access to any save files nor any version of them at any given time. This means that, unfortunately, we cannot help you recover your lost progress. What we can do is help you understand how this process works and where the files are located.

What players can do to make sure they can save their files in the cloud and use them on other computers is through Steam Cloud Save. The way we had to setup the saving process for Steam Cloud Save ties your save file to your Steam Account ID and it uses this info when you start the game to find the data, which means you have to open the game through steam to make sure everything will work.

We realized that most of the players that reported this issue to us lost their progress close to an update or when we push quick patches to solve some issues. We know that Steam Cloud does not synchronize properly when the version the player currently has doesn't match the latest version so make sure to update your game to the latest version before launching the game again and make sure Steam Cloud is properly synchronized. In our experience, we found out that restarting Steam forces it to update games.

With that said, we want to show you where you can find the files in your computer in case you want to create a manual backup or check them.

You can find the saves on your computer at: 

For windows users:  
LocalDisk/Users/(yourcomputeruser)/AppData/LocalLow/FlannelBearGames/CraftySurvivors 

For Mac users:
~/Library/Application Support/FlannelBearGames/CraftySurvivors

Here you will be able to find a folder that is named after your Steam ID, usually represented by a series of numbers. Inside this folder you will be able to see your save file named as saveState.dat and the saved settings as settingsSaveState.dat. 

IMPORTANT: If there is a "saveState.dat" file that is located OUTSIDE this folder, it is a different saved progress that is used when you launch the game without Steam being opened. This save is not linked to any account and is not saved on Steam Cloud. That is why it is important to always launch the game through steam, so you can make progress on the proper save file. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919706/c84a92cce8dff8de041c51f6f5a7ba624becd5da.png

Here are also a link that may help you understand/solve your situation:
https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/68D2-35AB-09A9-7678


We hope this sheds some light on the situation and helps those who were affected.

notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 0.1.3.1

General Adjustments

Changed the visual priority of the Dropper Heart, pulling it to the front of everything, in order to improve visibility of it;
After grabbing the boss chest at the end of a Stage, characters will stop attacking when skills are set to auto.


Bug Fixes
Characters
Stoverick, the Chef

Fixed an issue where Stoverick could active Serve! without having his stacks.


Sewvia, the Seamstress

Fixed a bug with Sewvia's dodge Level 6 that would break the game if received through a chest.


Enemies

Fixed an issue with all enemies where they would maintain their debuffs after dying, respawning new enemies with the debuffs, which would make it impossible to get Bistro Stacks;
Fixed an issue where enemies that died behind a skill would break their silhouette mask, hindering some performance.


General

Fixed the visual layer of the Mushrooms in the Forest.
Other bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Note - v0.1.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 0.1.3

Character Adjustments
Axel, the Lumberjack

Axel is now able to dodge in the middle of Chopping Whirlwind, canceling the attack in order to avoid enemies and their attacks;
Added 2 more levels for Bountiful Trees;
Added 2 more levels for Iron Will.


Enemy Adjustments

Changed the behaviour of the Ranged Boss. It will no longer fire the giant fireball as it was an attack without an indication, but instead will fire multiple laser beams around itself.


Bug Fixes
Characters
Axel, the Lumberjack

Fixed a bug with Chopping Whirlwind level 5 that would do 50% of the damage instead of 50% extra damage.


General

Improved the overall performance of spawning enemies in the battlefield;
Improved the performance of Ranged Enemies on stages and reduced their numbers on all stages to minimize performance issues.



We hope this patch improves the overall performance of the game for a lot of players.
Thank you all for the support and the feedbacks!
